previewer.title: Skald sheet previewer
previewer.intro: Open a system's sheet in edit, play or print mode. Characters stay in this browser (localStorage); nothing is sent anywhere.
previewer.importFailed: That file is not a character JSON object.
previewer.notFound: No such system in this previewer.

rollLog.title: Roll log
rollLog.empty: Rolls you make on the sheet appear here.

packs.title: Content packs
packs.note: D&D 2024 packs in the skald/pack/v1 format. They stay in this tab's memory; a reload clears them.
packs.supplies: {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}, {overlays, plural, one {# overlay} other {# overlays}}
packs.mismatch: Built for other built-in data; some links may not resolve.

error.notJson: The file is not a JSON object.
error.wrongSystem: This file isn't a D&D 2024 content pack in the skald/pack/v1 format.
error.unsupportedVersion: This pack needs a newer version of the previewer.
error.shaMismatch: The checksum doesn't match: seal the pack again after every change.
error.failed: Couldn't check the pack. Try again.

previewer.unavailable: Not available in the previewer: table sessions, portrait upload, PDF download and Excel formulas.
